name: Your Company
tagline: Furniture from your sketch — from a napkin drawing to the finished piece

seo.title: Your Company — bespoke furniture from your sketch in Tashkent
seo.description: A furniture atelier in Mirabad: tables, dressers, bookcases and beds made from your sketch. Free drawings and 3D, made in 21 days and up, 2-year warranty.
seo.answer: Your Company is a furniture atelier in Tashkent (34 Shakhrisabz Street) that builds tables, dressers, wardrobes and beds from the client’s sketch. Drawings and 3D renders are free, production takes 21 days and up, a solid wood dining table starts at UZS 6,800,000, with a 2-year warranty.

listing.description: A site for a bespoke furniture atelier or joinery studio: a dark showcase with brass accents, a catalogue with starting prices, the path from sketch to delivery and a gallery of work.

sections.title: You draw it, we build it
sections.subtitle: Bring a sketch, a Pinterest photo or just the size of the niche. We turn the idea into a drawing, show it in 3D and make a piece nobody else has.

sections.label: Atelier
sections.title: Furniture you won’t find in a showroom
sections.text:
We don’t sell ready-made models — every piece starts with your drawing.
Our designer turns the sketch into a technical drawing, chooses the wood, hardware and fabric, and you approve the 3D before the first board is cut. We work with oak, ash, walnut and veneer, finished with oil, wax or matte lacquer.

sections.label: What we make
sections.title: Starting prices — the final one comes with the drawing

items.title: Meeting
items.text: We discuss the sketch at the atelier or come to measure — free within Tashkent.

items.title: Drawing and 3D
items.text: In 3–5 days we prepare the drawing, a 3D render and an exact quote.

items.title: Samples
items.text: You choose wood, finish and fabric in person, on real samples.

items.title: Making
items.text: From 21 working days, with photos from the workshop.

items.title: Delivery and assembly
items.text: We deliver, assemble and take the packaging away. 2-year warranty.

items.quote: I brought a drawing on a notebook page and got a dresser exactly as I imagined it.
items.author: Nigora

items.quote: They showed the 3D in advance, we changed the legs twice at no extra cost.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: The bookcase fit the niche to the millimetre.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.q: Do I need to be able to draw?
items.a: No. Photos from the internet, measurements and a few words are enough — our designer will draw it.
Drawings, 3D and the quote are free. You only pay for the piece.
50% upfront after the 3D is approved, the rest after assembly. Cash, transfer or card.
Two years on the structure and hardware. We come back for free a year later to adjust the fronts.

items.q: Do you make furniture for restaurants and offices?
items.a: Yes, from a single table to a fully furnished hall. Timing and price are calculated separately.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Send us your drawing
sections.text: Take a photo of your sketch and send it on Telegram — the same day we will tell you what to make it from and what it will cost.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Furniture catalogue
sections.text: Add to cart and check out — we will call to confirm and deliver.
